subject: Invoice & procurement follow-up — PO vs Card, invoice fields, VAT
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo — next steps on procurement & invoicing

Hi Alex — thanks again for the demo today, really enjoyed the discussion and the use case walk-through. Quick recap and suggested next steps on the commercial path so we can keep momentum:

- Procurement readiness: does Acme prefer to pay via PO (net terms) or corporate card for the initial reserved capacity? If PO, any standard timelines for issuance?
- Invoice requirements: can you confirm billing contact, billing address, VAT/tax ID (if applicable), and whether you need line-item detail or one-line invoice?
- Marketplace interest: are you open to procurement via AWS Marketplace/Google Marketplace (we can offer consolidated invoicing) or do you need a direct vendor invoice?

If you like, I can send over a pro forma invoice + our MSA to speed the PO review. Rishi (copied) will handle any SOW/technical attachments.

Proposed next step: if you can share procurement contact and their required invoice template (or attach a PO requirements PDF), I’ll loop in Legal/Finance and produce the documents this week.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

Attachment: Redwood_MSA_v3.1.pdf (sent on request)

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acmeanalytics.com>, Sana Malik <sana.malik@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo — next steps on procurement & invoicing

Thanks Marissa — great session. Quick answers below and attaching our PO requirements doc for reference.

- Payment preference: We typically run a PO process for any committed multi-month spend. For initial pilots we sometimes do a corporate card, but for Dedicated capacity we expect to go via PO.
- Timeline: Our procurement team usually takes ~10 business days to complete review once they have the MSA + pro forma invoice.
- Invoice fields: See attached (Acme_PO_requirements.pdf) — they require: full legal name, billing address, remit-to address, EIN, VAT ID (if foreign vendor), invoice number, invoice date, payment terms (Net30), and line-item description with unit price and total.
- Marketplace: We prefer direct vendor invoice for this purchase (do not use Marketplace for Dedicated buys).

Procurement contact is Sana Malik (copied) — she’ll be the day-to-day for the PO. Sana, Marissa will send MSA + pro forma invoice; could you confirm the remit-to address and whether Net30 is acceptable?

Best,
Alex
Director of ML Platforms | Acme Analytics
alex.johnson@acmeanalytics.com

Attachment: Acme_PO_requirements.pdf

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Sana Malik <sana.malik@acmeanalytics.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo — next steps on procurement & invoicing

Hi Sana — quick technical note from the onboarding side: for Dedicated we’ll need a technical point of contact to coordinate IP allowlisting and networking (VPC peering/egress rules). Can you share the name/email of the person on your infra team? That will not impact the PO but helps reduce lead time.

Also, for the invoice we typically provide: Redwood Inc. (legal name), Redwood Inference LLC (if required), EIN 84-1234567, and our standard remit-to bank wiring instructions. If Acme needs specific PO line descriptions, tell us the preferred level of detail and we can add it to the pro forma.

Thanks — copying Marissa who’ll own the commercial docs.

Rishi
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai

From: Procurement Team <procurement@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmeanalytics.com>, Sana Malik <sana.malik@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 08:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo — next steps on procurement & invoicing

Marissa / Rishi — thanks for the info. Confirming: Net30 is acceptable. Attached is a short PDF with our required invoice layout and fields (same as Alex mentioned). Our billing address and remit-to are in the attachment. We also need a W-9 (US vendors) or equivalent tax documentation for foreign vendors.

Estimated PO issuance timeline: 7-10 business days after legal completes the MSA review. We will accept electronic invoices (PDF) sent to billing@acmeanalytics.com with the PO number in the subject line.

Please send the pro forma invoice and MSA to procurement@acmeanalytics.com and billing@acmeanalytics.com. For legal redlines, send them to legal@acmeanalytics.com and we’ll coordinate.

Thanks,
Acme Procurement Team

Attachment: Acme_PO_requirements.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Procurement Team <procurement@acmeanalytics.com>, Sana Malik <sana.malik@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmeanalytics.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 24 May 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo — next steps on procurement & invoicing

Thanks — attaching the pro forma invoice (one-line subscription + one-line setup) and our standard MSA (Redwood_MSA_v3.1.pdf). Also included a W-9 as requested.

Short next steps from our side:
1) Legal: please review the attached MSA and send any redlines to legal@redwood.ai (cc me). We can fast-track review for PO-only purchases (no modifications at start).
2) Procurement: once you confirm remit-to address and PO workflow, we’ll mark this as ready for PO issuance.
3) Operations: Rishi will coordinate networking onboarding once we have contract/P.O.

If Net30 and the attached invoice format look good, we can expect a PO in ~7-10 business days per your note. If a faster pilot is needed we can accept a card payment for the first month and then convert to PO for the committed term.

Thanks all — happy to jump on a quick call if that helps.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: Redwood_MSA_v3.1.pdf, Redwood_ProForma_Acme_RDW-374.pdf, Redwood_W-9.pdf
